# SVICLOUD TV Box US — Product and Support Reference

This storefront provides SVICLOUD device specifications, hardware connection guidance, U.S. shipping information, policies and order support.

## Hardware
SVICLOUD 15P specifications include Android 14, Amlogic S905Y5, 4 GB RAM, 64 GB storage, Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4. For the current price, availability, included accessories and full specifications, consult https://svicloudtvbox.us/product/svicloud-15p/

Product lineup: https://svicloudtvbox.us/shop/
Model comparison: https://svicloudtvbox.us/compare/
15P hardware details: https://svicloudtvbox.us/svicloud-15p-features/

## Device connections
Connect HDMI and the supplied power adapter, select the correct TV input, connect Wi-Fi or Ethernet, and check the remote and audio.
Hardware guide: https://svicloudtvbox.us/guides-setup/
Troubleshooting: https://svicloudtvbox.us/guides-troubleshooting/
